topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: The filter's suppression of 19th harmonics can improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations by up to 10% in some cases. This is because suppressing 19th harmonics reduces intermodulation products (IMDs) and adjacent channel interference (ACI), leading to more efficient power usage. However, the effectiveness of this approach depends on the specific satellite system and modulation schemes used, and careful resource management is required to balance power savings and system complexity.
